ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio (approximately 0.05:0.95) with dark-spectrum pixels dominating over 90% of the visible ventral surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Disseminated fine-grained white stippling pattern distributed across both dark-pigmented lobes; absence of large-scale contiguous white geometric blobs.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct U-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 105-110 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the entire trailing boundary with peak-to-valley amplitudes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate concave curvature fitted to the trailing edges extending from the median notch to the distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of discrete, circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (1-4 pixel radius) scattered across both dark lobes, consistent with localized scarring.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive punctate white scarring distributed across the dark field of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetric, jagged serration profile on the distal edge of the left lobe compared to the more uniform serration on the right lobe.
